name: apex
description: APEX — Standardized Physical Therapy Examination & Documentation. San Pedro College Physical Therapy Department.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
